In '''0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]''', many events took place that would shake [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] continued, while many other conflicts were taking place across the galaxy.

==Events==
*35:10:8&mdash;Remnants of the disbanded [[Dentaalian House]] meet and pass a resolution declaring that [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]] will no longer recognize [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Taliff]]'s [[Imperial Charter/Legends|Imperial Charter]].<ref name="GNN5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*35:10:28&mdash;[[Dentaal Uprising]]<ref name="GNN5" />
*36:F1:1&mdash;During [[New Year Fete Week/Legends|New Year Fete Week]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] condemns the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="TEA178">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*36:1&mdash;[[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] was annexed into the Galactic Empire and [[Wilek Nereus]] was placed as its [[Governor/Legends|Governor]].<ref name="GNN5" />
*36:1:13&mdash;The [[Imperial Space Ministry/Legends|Imperial Space Ministry]] and the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] issue a [[Captain's Accredited License/Legends|Captain's Accredited License]] to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="BHC1">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>
*36:2:22&mdash;An outbreak of [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] begins affecting hundreds of thousands of people in [[Calif City]] on Dentaal.<ref name="GNN5" />
*36:2:23&mdash;In response to the appearance of Candorian plague on Dentaal, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] enforces a medical quarantine of the [[Dentaal system/Legends|Dentaal system]].<ref name="GNN5" />
*The [[Blockade of Ralltiir]].<ref name="GNN3">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*One hundred aging [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] enter the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] spacedocks to undergo extensive system upgrades and refitting.<ref name="J10:231">{{JournalCite|10|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*The Empire institutes the [[Yavin blockade]], which lasts for six months.<ref name="SW 3-D #2">[[Star Wars 3-D 2|''Star Wars 3-D'' 2]]</ref>
*[[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] [[Mission to Dantooine|defected]] to the Rebellion during an Imperial invasion on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="SW:RSIII">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>
*The Rebellion's [[Evacuation of Yavin|exodus]] from Yavin 4 proved to be successful.<ref name="Imperial Spy">{{Kids1997Cite|issue1=11|issue2=15|story=Imperial Spy}}</ref>
*The Rebels sought refuge on multiple outposts, including [[Tak Base]] on [[Talay/Legends|Talay]],<ref name="Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref> [[Ring Base]] in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]]<ref name="TSotFW">''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]''</ref> and [[Thila Command]] on [[Thila/Legends|Thila]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>
*The Rebellion enforced anti-Imperial [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] across the galaxy for [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroying]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], which sent the Empire into [[Politics/Legends|political]] decline.<ref name="Galaxies: AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
*The [[Ejolus]] colony was established by the Rebels for the remaining [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] to reside on, but was [[Destruction of the Ejolus outpost|wiped out]] by the Empire eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*Alliance member [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] for the Rebel Alliance to establish as a new base when necessary.<ref name="Imperial Spy" />
*The Alliance to Restore the Republic founded [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]] for the [[Alderaan Alliance]]&mdash;led by the [[Alderaanian Council]]&mdash;to live on, since their previous new home had been destroyed.<ref name="DarkEmpire II 5: TGW">[[Dark Empire II 5|''Dark Empire II'' 5]]</ref>
*The [[Conference of Uncommitted Worlds]] took place.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="TCSWE" />
*The [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[super-vaporator]] project was sabotaged.<ref name="TMotRR">''[[The Mystery of the Rebellious Robot]]''</ref>
*Imperial [[Procurator of Justice]] [[Hethrir]] used a [[hive virus]] to destroy all life on his home planet of [[Firrerre/Legends|Firrerre]] on the order of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref><ref name="Jedi Academy TM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>
*[[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] defected from the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="RS">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>
*The [[Marblewood Estate heist]] took place.<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
*[[Zsinj]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to prevent the powerful [[Witches of Dathomir]] to from escaping their planet.<ref name="Despoilers">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-1|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>
